description: Diagnostic module that checks rug_pull_monitor.py heartbeat age (currently 650h50m stale, threshold 28800s). Queries service_health for last_heartbeat timestamp. Inspects the daemon source to verify it has a heartbeat loop and is configured in supervisord_sentinel_full.conf. Outputs recommendation: whether the daemon needs manual restart, service file correction, or if heartbeat logic is missing. DO NOT generate a restart directive or rebuild the file (rug_pull_monitor is protected).
